features.quote: If the exact same Action payload is emitted 3 times consecutively, the harness halts the run, tags it collapsed, and assigns a provisional SI of 0.95. This saves ~25–40% of token spend
features.justification_quote: This saves ~25–40% of token spend on Tier-S tasks.

features.quote: Max turns: 30 for full runs; 20 for smoke-screen runs.
